sign_out.step_description: Call clear_site_data with domain='nike.com' to clear all Nike cookies and storage. Then navigate to https://www.nike.com and verify the page shows an unauthenticated state (no account greeting).
sign_out.expected_result: Nike session should be cleared. Page should show 'Join Us / Sign In' or similar unauthenticated state with no account greeting.

sign_in.step_description: Sign in to Nike using email 'happyautoec@outlook.com' and password 'Happy@1234'. IMPORTANT: call email_mark_baseline BEFORE submitting the email, so that get_email_verification_code can later retrieve only freshly-arrived codes. If Nike asks for an email verification code instead of a password, call get_email_verification_code (sender_filter='nike', timeout_seconds=60) to retrieve it. Goal: reach an authenticated state where the account is recognized.
sign_in.expected_result: User should be successfully signed in to Nike. Page should show account icon or greeting indicating authenticated state.

handle_cart.step_name: Navigate to cart page and handle cart items
handle_cart.step_description: Go to the Nike cart (https://www.nike.com/cart). Remove any unavailable items (sold out, out of stock, etc.). If the cart ends up empty, add any one available product. Goal: cart has at least one valid item ready for checkout.
handle_cart.expected_result: Cart has at least one valid item ready for checkout.

navigate_to_checkout.step_description: Proceed from the cart to checkout. Goal: reach the Nike checkout page (https://www.nike.com/checkout) with cart items loaded.
navigate_to_checkout.expected_result: Checkout page loaded with cart items.

init_log_monitor.step_description: Call logmonitor_init to start monitoring Edge logs for autofill status. Skip if already initialized.

trigger_autofill_popup.step_description: Goal: get the email or firstName input field focused so Edge's autofill popup appears. Do whatever it takes on the current checkout page to reach these inputs — the page may require clicking Edit or similar buttons first to expose input fields. Once the field is focused: use cdp_click to click it ONCE, wait 2 seconds, then call uia_wait_for_popup (timeout: 5 seconds). If popup not detected, retry once with os_click on the same field, wait 2 seconds, then uia_wait_for_popup (timeout: 5 seconds).
trigger_autofill_popup.expected_result: The selected field should be cleared and focused. Edge's Express Checkout autofill popup should appear and be detected by UIA (popup visible, regardless of option count).

uia_click_autofill.step_description: Use uia_select_autofill action to click the first autofill option in the detected popup. This should trigger the autofill process to fill all form fields.
uia_click_autofill.expected_result: UIA should successfully click the autofill button, and form fields (email, firstName, lastName, address, etc.) should be automatically filled

wait_autofill_log.step_name: Wait for autofill completion via log monitor
wait_autofill_log.step_description: Call logmonitor_wait_for_state with expected_state='AutofillSucceeded' and timeout=30 to confirm autofill completed.

verify_profile_filtered.step_description: Call logmonitor_get_filter_results. Check that all invalid profiles are FILTERED with a non-zero failed_reason, and at least one profile is VALID.
verify_profile_filtered.expected_result: All invalid profiles FILTERED with non-zero failed_reason. At least 1 profile VALID.

test_cases.test_case_description: Navigate to Nike checkout page as guest, trigger autofill popup, and click autofill button. Preconditions: Edge browser has at least one saved address

Sign in to Nike with a registered account, navigate to checkout, trigger autofill popup, verify invalid profiles are filtered, then complete autofill. Account: happyautoec@outlook.com / Happy@1234. Preconditions: (1) Edge has at least one fully valid saved address. (2) Edge also has 5 additional saved address profiles each with exactly one invalid field and all other fields valid: name='1', zip='1', phone='1', invalid email format (e.g. 'e650628.g. 1'), city='1'.
